howto.what: 它会从 channels 分支把 Webex 适配器及其注册测试复制到 src/channels/,往 barrel 追加一行 import,安装 @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex@0.1.0,再跑构建和注册测试。所有步骤都是幂等的,可安全重跑。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 加 Webex 渠道时触发;它会执行 Apply 里的复制、注册、装依赖与验证。要真正收发消息,还需人工在 Webex 开发者门户建机器人并配好凭据与 webhook。

say.text: 帮我把 Webex 渠道接进 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并跑构建与测试

say.text: 跑一遍 add-webex 的 Apply 步骤
Webex 的 Bot Token 和 webhook secret 怎么填?

howto.what_en: It copies the Webex adapter and its registration test from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends one import line to the barrel, installs @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex@0.1.0, then runs the build and the registration test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Webex channel to NanoClaw; it applies the copy, registration, dependency and validation steps. Bot credentials and webhook setup are still manual.

say_en.text: Add the Webex channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, runs build and test
Directives are idempotent and safe to re-run

say_en.text: How do I set the Webex bot token and webhook secret?
